recommendations.name: Teenage Engineering’s Computer-2 PC case
recommendations.blurb: This small form factor PC case has some awesome Teenage Engineering flair. I love the hazy, semi-transparent look. Even better, the company is also giving it away for free — that is, when it’s back in stock again. At least you can sign up for a waitlist.

recommendations.name: Fairphone’s new cables and chargers
recommendations.blurb: Fairphone says its new accessories are more durable than what it offered before and made with sustainability in mind. They seem like solid cables and chargers, too, so they could be a great option if you like Fairphone’s mission.

recommendations.name: Alien: Earth
recommendations.blurb: FX’s new series set in the Alien universe is getting great reviews . My knowledge of the Alien franchise is limited to Alien and Aliens , but Alien: Earth looks really scary — and I’m overdue for a good scary show.

recommendations.name: GuliKit’s ES and ES Pro controllers
recommendations.blurb: If you want a higher-end Switch 2 controller but don’t want to pay $89.99, GuliKit’s new $24.99 and $29.99 options are considerably more affordable and offer perks like anti-drift joysticks. The controllers work on PC, Android, iOS, and macOS, too.

recommendations.name: OFF
recommendations.blurb: This surreal RPG , starring a baseball player on a mission to purify the world from ghosts, is now available in a modernized version on Steam and Nintendo Switch. I’ve played a little bit of it, and it’s quite strange — which I say in the most complimentary way.

recommendations.name: Enter the Gungeon and Exit the Gungeon on mobile
recommendations.blurb: The hit roguelike Enter the Gungeon is now available on iOS and Android for the first time, while Exit the Gungeon is back on iOS and has arrived on Google Play. Watch out for bullets.

recommendations.name: Nobody 2
recommendations.blurb: The sequel to 2021’s Nobody , starring Bob Odenkirk, as a former assassin is now in theaters. I never caught the first, but I love basically everything Odenkirk does, so I’m guessing I’d have a lot of fun with these.

recommendations.name: The Penguin
recommendations.blurb: Just got to watching The Penguin , and it’s a really fun gangster romp set in Gotham. I’ve mostly tired of the superhero stuff, but I’m always a sucker for good origin tales, and this really delivers. And the secret is, it’s really about Sofia Falcone and her war with her patriarchal mob family.

recommendations.name: UFO 50
recommendations.blurb: UFO 50 just came out on the Nintendo Switch. I’ve been following the podcast Eggplant: The Secret Lives of Gamers , which is going through each of the 50 games in a book club-like format, with just one game a week.

recommendations.name: Barbarian
recommendations.blurb: I, like many other people, watched Barbarian recently on Netflix. It’s leaving on August 31st. The director’s new movie, Weapons , just came out. Highly, highly recommend Barbarian . It’s fun to go in blind, and even if you’ve seen the trailer, you’ll still be spared some of its great twists.
